title: Protocol-first Ethereum discovery and automatic verified-source handoff

requirements.text: Treat web search results as document leads and never use page hostname/title alone as protocol candidate identity.
Reject academic papers, generic developer-resource lists, and other document-only leads from Results unless a concrete protocol identity can be conservatively resolved.
Promote a protocol candidate only after an Ethereum Mainnet address is resolved and Etherscan returns verified source metadata.
Resolve proxy implementation addresses within the configured Etherscan lookup budget and avoid duplicate or cyclic lookups.
Automatically hand verified source to the existing source analyzer when inspection is enabled and surface contract/source counts on the protocol candidate.
Fail closed when Etherscan is unavailable or the lookup budget is zero: report an explicit progress reason and return no misleading protocol candidates.
Keep discovery passive and bounded: search plus read-only Etherscan source metadata only, with no RPC probing, transactions, exploit execution, or private-key handling.
Preserve report address redaction and existing desktop/CLI analysis behavior.
